name: foundry-sentinel-state-grpc-v2
mission: Close the remaining sentinel control-plane gap from the current Foundry baseline. Registry and campaign state are already daemon-authoritative, while sentinel list/show still read client-side sentinels.json and enable/disable still permit implicit daemon-unreachable fallback. Make foundryd the sole online owner of sentinel definitions and scheduler-visible state: list, show, enable, and disable use typed gRPC; daemon-unreachable online commands never read or mutate client files; explicit --offline remains the only direct-file recovery path. Preserve canonical seeding, additive default merging, scheduler wake-up semantics, and loopback compatibility.

done_evidence.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace

done_evidence.statement: Real CLI or generated-client boundary tests run sentinel list, show, enable, and disable against populated daemon-owned state with an isolated absent or trap client FOUNDRY_SENTINELS_PATH. They assert exact sentinel name, cron, event type, project, throttle, payload, and enabled state, and prove online commands neither read nor mutate the client file.

Daemon-unreachable online list, show, enable, and disable fail with stable actionable errors and no local fallback. Explicit --offline recovery for all supported sentinel operations remains documented and tested.

Concurrent sentinel mutations are serialized and persistence-atomic, successful enable/disable changes wake the scheduler consistently, and failed persistence leaves daemon memory, scheduler-visible state, and disk byte-identical.

Documentation accurately describes daemon-authoritative sentinel reads and mutations, explicit offline recovery, canonical additive seeding, scheduler reload behavior, and the boundary between this campaign and future sentinel add/edit/remove work.

escalation: Moving sentinel reads behind gRPC requires intentionally changing canonical seed or scheduler semantics.
A behavior choice would expand scope into sentinel add, edit, or remove.
The same objective fails required validation twice.
The agent provider is unavailable because of authentication, rate, or spend capacity.
